name: zanker-design-decisions
description: Record visual alternatives, rationale, approvals, failures and evidence for future sessions.

workflow.instruction: Read existing studio event log and product context.
Create an append-only decision record with scope, context, alternatives, evidence and selection.
Store relative source and screenshot references, without private user data.
Do not replace new user requirements with old preference; detect contradictory decisions.

fallback: Store pending recommendation without labeling it approved.
